content: For receptions the TcpIp Module shall accept UDP datagrams containing a zero checksum only on sockets that have been configured accordingly (i.e. TcpIp_ChangeParameter() has been called with TCPIP_PARAMID_UDP_CHECKSUM set to FALSE) .
